purpose: User requested reduction of inclusive total-model-parameter hard-exclusion threshold from 250B to 150B; model parameter gate precedes S1/S2/S3 forecast, cost, and runtime.
rule: model total parameters >=150,000,000,000 are EXCLUDED. Unknown total blocks final lock and download. Applies to MoE total, regardless of activation, quantization or offload. Datasets exempt.
reason: User revised original hard upper bound from >=250B to >=150B, overriding previous rule.

source_research.method: Exa targeted primary model-card search and fetch plus previously archived Hugging Face 109-repo metadata
source_research.caution: Exa retrieves source text; this is a source-backed policy screen, not a fresh live weight-level hardware check.

replacement_operations.rationale: OrcaRouter Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Uncensored is ~180B total. Official upstream Qwen card explicitly lists 125B core +51B n-gram learned embedding +4B MTP; Hub and derivative model page call full checkpoint ~180B. Therefore >=150B even if 125B core and 6B active are cited. Model already HOLD; now EXCLUDED.
